tools.name: get_issue_details
tools.description: Get details for a Sentry issue: title, status, counts, latest event, breadcrumbs. Pass the issue URL, or organizationSlug plus issueId.

issueUrl.description: Full Sentry issue URL, e.g. https://my-org.sentry.io/issues/123/

issueId.description: Issue ID or short ID, e.g. 123 or PROJ-1A
